title: Keep provider error bodies out of spend-ledger diagnostics
description: SpendLedger.failed prints raw exception message to stderr; provider errors can echo credentials/private texts. CountingSyncClient invokes it before Stage0 can sanitize. Print safe exception class/status only, preserve failure/circuit/attempt counts. Regression spec injects secret/private body and asserts neither appears in stderr or summary. Narrow unified_spend.py/test fix only; no paid calls or broad logging framework. Required for Stage0 runner54743202.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed db8937a. Spec first proved raw secret/private body leaked to stderr, then diagnostic retains only class/status. Main independently ran full adjacent spend18 specs passed; count/circuit semantics unchanged.
